name: Sean Thomas
title: Business-First Full-Stack Software Engineer
about: I'm Sean Thomas — a business-first full-stack software engineer graduating from the University of Alabama (BS, Management Information Systems) in May 2026 and joining Valent Partners in Dallas, TX in August 2026.
I'm the founder of Signal Surge LLC, an IT consulting firm, and of WhoBrew (whobrew.us), an NFC-enabled business card platform that publicly launched in April 2026.
I also serve as a Sergeant in the 20th Special Forces Group, Alabama Army National Guard, holding a Top Secret/SCI clearance with CI Poly.
I love solving business problems elegantly with code — shipping ML, full-stack web, and automation that moves real numbers.
